home_features.title: Triage & Alerting
home_features.desc: NeuroAlert is a universal neuro-vascular alert system. We provide immediate clinical diagnosis via USSD to accelerate stroke care across Africa.
home_features.card1_desc: Interactive menus accessible on any feature phone via *789#.
home_features.card2_desc: Immediate stroke evaluation using Gemini models following FAST protocols.
home_features.card3_desc: Critical alerts pushed instantly to the medical dashboard the second risk is detected.
home_features.card4_desc: Automatic support for Hausa, Yoruba, Igbo, French, and English.
home_features.card5_desc: Real-time patient data synchronization to hospital portals.
home_features.card6_desc: Mapping emergency cases via cell tower triangulation for rapid response.

how_it_works.title: How it Works: USSD Dialing
how_it_works.step1_desc: No internet or smartphone required. Access the triage system instantly using standard USSD across all African Telcos.
how_it_works.step2_desc: The interactive menu guides the user through the F.A.S.T (Face, Arms, Speech, Time) check in their preferred language.
how_it_works.step3_desc: If critical, an immediate alert is pushed to the nearest hospital's dashboard.

product.title: The F.A.S.T USSD AI Agent
product.desc: NeuroAlert is not just a mobile app. It is an artificial intelligence engine integrated directly into African telecom networks (USSD). Without internet, our AI diagnoses and prevents stroke-related emergencies.
product.card1_desc: No 3G/4G connection required. The patient dials *789# and is charged zero FCFA. Infrastructure is hosted via Africa's Talking.
product.card2_desc: Our Gemini-based model analyzes USSD survey text responses (Face, Arms, Speech, Time) to evaluate critical probability.
product.card3_desc: The system automatically detects regional language (French, Hausa, Yoruba, Igbo) and asks culturally adapted F.A.S.T questions.
product.cta_desc: Discover how hospitals connect to the NeuroAlert API to receive patient alerts seconds after a critical FAST test.

pricing.title: A Freemium model accessible to all
pricing.desc: NeuroAlert is a unique product designed for impact. Totally free for end patients. Hospital and API costs are kept to a strict minimum through open-source and philanthropic support.
pricing.ong_desc: If you represent a non-profit working for public health, NeuroAlert provides its Premium infrastructure for free.

institutions.desc: NeuroAlert Premium dashboards transform civilian USSD signals into a tactical command room for health stakeholders. Optimize ambulance deployment before the patient even arrives.

institutions.partners_desc: Governments, global health actors, and telecom operators unite around NeuroAlert to democratize emergency alerting.
institutions.card1_desc: Be notified on your institutional screens as soon as a nearby patient triggers a major FAST test on USSD.
institutions.card2_desc: Identify clusters of neuro-critical events. Export your analyses for the Ministry of Health.
institutions.card3_desc: Coordinate emergency response teams. Share the F.A.S.T report instantly via digitized PDF.

developers.title: Build with NeuroAlert
developers.desc: We believe in an open web. Integrate F.A.S.T triage intelligence directly into your hospital systems via our documented APIs or contribute to our open-source code.

about.title: Our Story & Mission
about.desc: Born from an alarming observation of delayed stroke care in Sub-Saharan Africa, NeuroAlert aims to democratize access to instant AI diagnosis for non-connected populations.
about.problem_p1: Africa records 316 stroke cases per 100,000 inhabitants, one of the highest rates in the world. The main challenge is not medical, it is logistical: diagnosis happens too late because populations misidentify symptoms and lack quick internet access to search for information.
about.problem_p2: The 'Golden Hour' standard (treating stroke within 60 minutes) is often a mirage. 80% of stroke-related deaths can be avoided if thrombolysis is administered in time.
about.solution_p1: By coupling USSD technology (universal in Africa) with an AI conversational agent (LLM), we bring a neurologist's expertise directly to a $10 feature phone's alphanumeric keypad.
about.solution_p2: NeuroAlert requires neither download nor data plan. Just an emergency number *789# and an AI translation system conscious of local context (French, Hausa, Yoruba).

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.desc: All answers to your questions about the platform, from medical technology to network infrastructure.
faq.q1: What is USSD and why use it?
faq.a1: Unlike a standard mobile app, USSD (*789#) works on all phone models (feature phones) without internet connection. It is the most accessible technology in Africa, used daily for Mobile Money.
faq.q2: Is the service actually free for patients?
faq.a2: Yes. Partnering with telcos and through the Freemium model financed by hospital queries, the distressed patient pays nothing to diagnose and trigger the alert.
faq.q3: How does AI detect a stroke without seeing the patient?
faq.a3: The system uses the modeled international F.A.S.T protocol. Asking simple questions to bystanders (Is the face asymmetrical? Can they lift arms?), our LLM evaluates clinical coherence of responses.
faq.q4: What data is shared with the hospital?
faq.a4: In case of a critical alert, NeuroAlert automatically pushes a report containing: probability level, approximate Cell-Tower location (if authorized), and estimated time of onset (the 'Time' in F.A.S.T).
faq.a5: Hospitals use our 'Institutions' portal to visualize the heatmap. Push alerts and Webhooks can be configured to send information to their existing management tools (HIS).
